title: Well-formed gates in each prefix
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit whose gates use only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND operations. For every natural number $M$, each gate in the list through layer $M$ has pairwise distinct argument vertices, and if its kind is NOT then it has exactly one argument.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit over $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ with $n$ inputs and output type $\mathrm{Unit}$
Every gate operation of $F$ is identity, NOT, or unbounded fan-in AND
The gate belongs to the list through layer $M$
